scope: 25 complete DE/FR/ES/JA/KO editions; bounded corrections to existing ZH/EN; Traditional Chinese derived from corrected ZH; existing article URLs retained.
review_boundary: Root read all five Chinese essays. Language reviewers read every assigned target essay against the Chinese source and all package notes; the Spanish reviewer additionally read all five existing English essays. Root verifies shared factual decisions, proposed English changes and final changed target-language passages before freeze.
preservation: Original Chinese and English body snapshots are immutable. Source copyedits are exact once-only replacements, preserving all paragraph and section boundaries. Received ZIPs and external author files are unchanged. Localized essays retain all arguments and examples, rather than being replaced with summaries.

limitations: Targeted fact checks of flagged passages, not a fresh verification of every statistic or a replacement of the author's interpretations. Unsupported certainty about the motive for delaying the Parrish decision was removed, not replaced with another asserted motive. Small statistical values not in dispute were preserved with their original historical scope. Source PDFs were used only to the extent of text actually retrieved, not claimed to have been fully read.
